messages:
Asha Menon: FYI customer Opterra flagged renewal INV-2026-1407 — platform fee and support lines don't match the signed amendment. Can someone triage? :thinking:

Leo Grant: drop sub id and invoice snippet and I'll pull the ledger.

Asha Menon: subscription OPT-PRI-33. invoice excerpt:
```
INV-2026-1407
Customer: Opterra Analytics
Subscription: OPT-PRI-33
Private Deployment (reserved GPUs) - $50,000/year
Platform Fee - $20,000/year
Support - Elite - $15,000/year
Total Due: $85,000
```
Signed amendment (2026-01-28, CRM OPT-820) shows Platform Fee $10,000 and Support = Standard $6,000. Customer says sales committed to a waived trial of extra pools.

Billing Bot: invoice INV-2026-1407 generated by billing-service at 2026-07-15T13:02:41Z.

Cecilia (Acct Ops): quick checks: ledger shows a platform true-up of +10k from two short reserve_pool events during the term, and support_sku got mapped to Elite on renewal. Meter excerpt:
```
2026-03-02 OPT-PRI-33 reserve_pool create rp-210 dur=22d
2026-04-11 OPT-PRI-33 reserve_pool create rp-233 dur=18d
2026-05-12 billing-run trueup platform_fee_delta=+10000
```
Hiro (Sales): confirmed I approved the trial pools to be waived (slack DM and sales email). Signed amendment downgrades support to Standard. I filed both to CRM on 2026-02-02.

Leo Grant: recommended remediation:
- waive platform true-up $10,000 (credit) per sales approval
- correct support from Elite ($15k) to Standard ($6k) and issue $9,000 correction credit
- reissue invoice showing credits and attach signed amendment + sales waiver email

Asha Menon: combined credits = $19,000. Finance approval needed? Oliver usually approves but he's OOO. Who can sign?

Cecilia (Acct Ops): Finance can approve up to $25k for contract-correcting credits. Proceeding. I'll set ticket priority high and include revrec memo.

Billing Bot: credit CR-2026-881 created for INV-2026-1407 amount $19,000. Reissued invoice INV-2026-1407-R. Memo: "Waive approved trial reserve pools and correct support tier per signed amendment."

Hiro (Sales): emailing customer now with the corrected invoice and confirming waiver.

Leo Grant: credits applied and docs attached. Marking ticket BILL-2026-412 as resolved. Closing thread.
